status: REPRESENTATIVE RECONSTRUCTION from public sources. Not any manufacturer's CAD, not silicon-validated. Contains no temperatures from the SentiLab repo (old HotSpot 7.0 detailed-3D kelvin values are withdrawn).

conventions.stack_order: integer levels bottom-to-top: -1 under the board, 0 board, 1 BGA ... 9 top dies, 10 TIM1, 11 lid, 12 TIM2, 13 cooler, 14 coolant. Decimals order sub-layers inside an assembly. Parts sharing a level sit side by side or are alternatives (see variant).
conventions.thickness_um: {min, typical, max} only where a source gives them; null = not sourced. render_hint = an illustrative display value that is NOT a sourced claim (basis given).
conventions.k_W_per_mK: thermal conductivity near room temperature unless stated; 'derived' entries show their inputs.
conventions.sources: fact ids resolve to evidence/<lane>/FACTS.jsonl (verbatim quotes, verified) and source slugs to source_index.
conventions.variant: all | lidded | lidless | cowos_r | cowos_l_or_emib | ascend910 | liquid_cooled | air_cooled | vertical_power_delivery
